entries.zh: 居；居住、住居；亦指居所、住处
entries.en: to dwell, reside, inhabit; abode, dwelling

entries.zh: 住；居住
entries.en: to live, dwell, reside

entries.zh: 寓；寄居、暂寓
entries.en: to sojourn, lodge (temporarily), reside

entries.zh: 寓居；客居他乡、旅居异地（作客他邦而居）
entries.en: to reside in another's land; to live abroad as a sojourner

entries.zh: 自居；独居（一人独住）
entries.en: to live alone, dwell by oneself

entries.zh: 常館；常住学馆，寓居王家学院（马尼拉官学学舍住宿）
entries.en: to lodge in the king's (royal) college; to reside permanently in a college hall

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑：说、言、表白（据西语词头推断）〕
entries.en: 〔text damaged, gloss uncertain: to speak, say, talk, manifest (inferred from the Spanish headword)〕
entries.notes: M 栏止于「sa [残]」，R 栏多字污损难辨（T99），仅西语词头 Hablar/decir/parlar/manifestar 与汉字「咀」可读，未能四栏互证。

entries.zh: 说；说话、言说
entries.en: to speak, say, talk

entries.zh: 讲；讲说、说话
entries.en: to speak, say, tell, talk

entries.zh: 谈；交谈；谈想（思量、领会）；谈论（商量、讨论、咨询）
entries.en: to talk, converse; to ponder so as to understand; to discuss, consult

entries.zh: 词；言语、话语、言词
entries.en: words, speech, discourse; to speak, talk

entries.zh: 默；沉默寡言，只说必要的话
entries.en: taciturn; to speak only what is necessary, to keep silent

entries.zh: 报；告知、报说、表白（报告）
entries.en: to report, tell, announce; to make known, declare

entries.zh: 乱讲；说话不知检点、口无遮拦；词头另记「道路高下」一义（存疑）
entries.en: to speak rashly, without restraint or due care; (a second, uncertain sense in the headword: path/road with rises and falls)
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（原编疑为「崎/峙」），且西语后半「camino con alto y bajo」与「说话」义未能互证，释义以前半为准。

entries.zh: 话多冗长；说起来没完、不知收束（谓饶舌者）
entries.en: to speak at length, be long-winded; (of men) who cannot bring their talk to an end
entries.notes: 西语「gn」为「que no」缩写展开（hombres que no saben acabar），M 栏音节与汉字「給」之对应未能确证，释义主要据西语词头。

entries.zh: 议；议论、据理而言，讲道理地讨论
entries.en: to discuss, deliberate; to speak with reason/argument
entries.notes: 西语词尾「en bols dice」未能确解（或为缩写/污损），M 栏首音声调污损难辨（T99）；释义据西语首义与汉字「議」互证。

entries.zh: 口头话；随口之语、口头言语（西语词头谓出恶言、说坏话）
entries.en: to speak bad/evil words, utter ill speech; cf. words of the mouth, offhand talk
entries.notes: 西语「hablar malas palabras」（出恶言）与汉字「口头话」（随口之言）语义未尽对齐，两义并录。

entries.zh: 语；交谈、友好对话（二人相与言）
entries.en: to converse, speak together amicably; speech, words

entries.zh: 讹；讹言妄语、喧嚷鼓噪（词头杂注难解，释义存疑）
entries.en: to clamor, make an uproar (tumult); to speak falsely, spread rumor
entries.notes: 西语词头含原稿更正标记（>r<）及难解外语词「mamer macaça」，仅 tumulto（喧闹）与汉字「訛」及叠音「gō gō」可互证，语义未能全定。

entries.zh: 吟；低吟、喃喃自语（含于齿间低声言）
entries.en: to mutter, murmur between the teeth; to chant, hum (吟)
